message.content: It leans **2022 SaaS template** rather than 2024 editorial. The "Get Started" button feels too generic and the overall layout lacks the asymmetric, high-contrast typography that defines current premium design. **Top 2 issues:** (1) The CTA button needs a more refined, understated treatment—think outlined or ghost style with micro-interactions. (2) The hero section requires bolder typographic hierarchy and more intentional negative space to achieve that editorial feel.
